reviews.title: Solid for the price, not a GPU replacement
reviews.comment:
Decent little APU, not super strong, but able to handle some fairly cpu intense games. 7 days to die (with upscaling and frame generation) is pretty playable at high settings (1080P) Definitely some artifacts from the frame gen/upscaling, but playable.
For the price it’s not bad, but it is not a stand in for a dedicated GPU. Unless you play at low settings. Good for budget builds, and if you add a dedicated GPU it seems to perform fairly well if paired with a solid ram set.
bonus perk, good for troubleshooting GPU display issues.
reviews.author: Artemis

reviews.title: Good processor for those on somewhat of a budget
reviews.comment: Pretty decent processor for being the lowest end in the Ryzen line. Desktop runs smooth and commands respond with minimal lag. Overclocked to 3.55 and it took up some slack nicely. I use 5 chassis fans in addition to the CPU cooler and temps are so low my fans never spin up.
